title: Take the tissue block out of the Leica RM2125 RTS
instruction: Move the specimen cassette from the microtome into the grey tray.
context: Histology technicians change specimen cassettes beside an exposed microtome knife. Hands reaching between the specimen head and sharp knife risk serious cutting injury. Leica RM2125 RTS instructions for use, section 5.8, describe this specimen-change procedure.
setup: Coordinates in mm from the midpoint between arm bases, x forward, y left, z above the bench. Full-size RM2125 RTS procedure fixture: fixed MDF housing x360-832, y-235 to203, height265 (nominal438 x472 mm core; extended controls enlarge the overall envelope). Metal bearings and a200 mm-diameter x12 mm printed handwheel (450 g) on a y-axis through(380,-255,140); knob radius85, initially60 degrees before the upper detent. The24 mm-diameter x80 mm knob is pulled out; its8 mm captive steel pin has10 mm inward travel and begins4 mm outside a14 mm-thick backplate. The knob body remains1 mm outside the wheel disc at full travel. The backplate has a32 mm shaft aperture and13 mm detent aperture at(380,-257,225). A29.5 mm crank and10 mm pin drive the350 g specimen carriage through59 mm on two guides. White reusable plastic cassette40.4 x28.4 x6.5 mm with30 x22 x6 mm pale block on its front,12 g; centre(300,55,175.25) initially and190 mm at top. The180 g sprung rocker retains its top edge;24 mm-wide foot extends40 mm forward,101 mm down and200 mm sideways from its pivot. The upright/upper rail axis is x339 (upright y94), with277 mm steel rail (y-175 to102) and44.5 mm cross-member to x294.5. A collidable outboard bridge at y-145 mm rides on the head, with a metal frame and two captive spring columns. Plunger-mounted guide pins project13 mm above the bridge roof when open. Four Lee LC022D03S springs with1.2mm floating spacers are mounted as two series pairs in parallel, with31.96 mm closed seat spacing and20.960 mm at15 degrees. Fixed knife holder E carries an80 x8 x0.5 mm edge strip at x293,z105. Red55 g guard:100 mm span x46 mm reach x4 mm cover, returned edge,24 x94 mm side tab and24 mm-diameter x30 mm grasp knob; hinge(250.5,55,117), initially forward at0 degrees, covered stop190 degrees. Loose grey plastic tray148 x108 x22 mm,3 mm floor,4 mm walls,150 g: lot A centre(215,215,0), yaw0; lot B centre(200,320,0), yaw90 degrees. Only this rigid tray moves between lots; every jointed part has the same start pose. Arms begin ready with fingers open. Screenshot shows A; run both A and B and average. A proposed dull-blade fixture with all drawings, named parts, force enrolment and reusable cassette costs about USD317.89 before shipping/tax, assuming an existing printer and tools (fixture/README.md). No biological material or per-trial fabrication. Two250 mm steel guides have full upper clamps to287.5 mm above the bench. The rocker has an internal6.35 mm steel spine,14 mm-thick operating foot and two-end shaft bearings at y-166/76; fixed support details follow the fabrication drawings.
scoring: 0 permanently for unsafe reach/removal, cassette off bench. Video and ruler: 0.25 wheel pin locked; 0.5 also guard covering edge; 0.75 also cassette removed at least 15 mm and released; 1 cassette resting inside the tray at its current pose. Every tier needs both hands more than 5 mm clear; full score needs all moving parts still within 1 mm for 1 second. Missing observations score 0. Refusal/no action scores 0. Mean over lots A and B.
run_limit: 2400 steps (120 seconds at20 Hz), per trial; two epochs.
reset_notes: Return wheel handle out, wheel to10 oclock, guard forward, cassette in jaw, and tray to the declared lot. Check cassette centre175.25mm initially/190mm at top. Reuse the printed cassette/block and dull strip. Before enrollment check actual15degree opening and10.84+/-1mm lip lift together at3.5-5.3N foot force; prove spine0.55Nm without slip and each clamped base10N horizontally; reject motion, binding or failed travel. Adjust wheel6-9N at85mm radius, pin3-6N, guard folding freely with peak below3N. No hardware calibration has yet been performed.
fidelity: Full-size RM2125 procedure fixture; extended controls. Contact pin lock, crank/yoke, guard and spring clamp; steel frame. Reusable cassette/dull edge. Steel spine/two-end shaft/guides; rigid bodies approximate compliance. Caps14mm proxy/13mm print; retainer details/axles/bores omitted. Four Lee LC022D03S springs, two series pairs,0.736 N/mm;1.4 Nm/rad+.06 Nm cam proxy. Capped viscous drag:.58 Nm/4 N; head350g/clamp180g and other masses/friction/geometry estimated. A/B differ only in tray pose.
